verdict.rationale: Render's own docs state that you connect your repo and ship with every push, which covers both parts of the story: linking a Git repo and deploying automatically on push. Its ephemeral previews for every change and per-pull-request copies of the stack reinforce a Git-driven deploy workflow. The support is a terse marketing line rather than detailed documentation. Missing for 10: in-depth docs on auto-deploy configuration (branch selection, toggling auto-deploy, supported Git providers), independent or hands-on corroboration of push-triggered deploys.

support.subject: As a developer, I can automatically deploy my app on every Git push
